Brazil Election Sees Debate Cancellation, Bomb Scare, and Online Gambling Concerns

An election debate in Brazil was cancelled, and a bomb scare occurred outside the Supreme Court. Concerns have been raised regarding online gambling and record-high debts in relation to the presidential election. Additionally, a Brazilian court ordered the removal of fake posts amidst a dispute over the election of a patron saint. Reports also indicate efforts by figures like Trump and Rubio to influence the election and regional control.
